# Replacement attorney: identity verification record

The donor ⟦PERSON|Velsa Orlinn⟧ has named ⟦PERSON|Nerovin Cale⟧ as a replacement attorney. This record accompanies the signed appointment and documents the replacement's personal registration details with the private records service. It does not itself activate the replacement appointment.

**Personal registration ID:** ⟦IDENTITY|PERSON_725183⟧

The records service assigns identifiers in this format to individual users. The identifier is copied from the original registration confirmation, including its uppercase prefix and underscore. It identifies the replacement attorney rather than the donor or the instrument as a whole.

The replacement must provide the registration confirmation when requesting access to the stored appointment. A request for access must also identify the event said to activate the replacement authority. The records service may supply a copy for review, but it must not represent that access alone proves that the activation condition has been met.

Any change to the registration entry must preserve the previous value and the reason for the change. The donor has not authorised substitution of another person merely because a registration record cannot be found immediately.

Contact for verification: ⟦EMAIL|nerovin.verification@dapple-vault.invalid⟧.

Acknowledged by ⟦PERSON|Nerovin Cale⟧ on 14 December 2026. The administrative fee is GBP 18, and paragraph 7.1 governs access requests.
